protocol.retentionPolicy: Both arms retain exact prior user prompts and delivered assistant prose, plus one actually model-delivered bookmark shown explicitly in B's user question. No prior tool/source payload, evidence hint ledger or raw model draft is restored outside that declared prose. Navigation retains trusted application conversation bookmark state across A/acknowledgment/B, but each public run_turn creates/closes a separate short-action session. The application resolves only the supplied delivered bookmark and still calls the normal authorized API. Compact retains its full selector. This explicit state-policy change is not a matched-prose-only or old-action revival comparison.
protocol.bookmarkPolicy: Scan successful actual model-input captures newest-first, and their tool replies newest-first. Use the latest delivered selected/full response containing original source text, in document/wire order. Navigation copies that document's actual sourceBookmark.read, preserving the whole original completed selection; compact copies the first original source row's readSelector. If no appropriate source bookmark was actually delivered, report it unavailable; do not substitute an expiring action or manufacture a target from gold source facts or hidden application state.

B: new public run_turn with exact declared prose history
visible bookmark attempted before reacquisition when available
navigation delivered source bookmark survives the new action session and resolves exact prior scope
normal current permission/source/snapshot validation on the read; no implicit target replacement
authorized reacquisition after genuine failure if required; no silently repaired request
all: record every source and acknowledgment turn including failures
no selective rerun after semantic failure
no unrequested internal IDs in delivered answer
all six-turn input/output and recovery costs counted
acceptance.interpretation: Manual review of actual successful model delivery, requests, resolution and source. A completed loop or safe refusal is not source-task success. Missing focused bookmark after failed A remains a failure, never repaired by the harness.

execution.timingBasis: execution admission startedAt to final provider response finishedAt; includes pre-model checks and pacing

quality.presentationFinding: Compact B correctly answered from a fresh complete read but included an unrequested full internal selector in both raw draft and delivered answer. Compact A and both navigation source answers did not expose internal IDs. Both acknowledgment turns were brief.
comparisonCaveats: This is one bounded source question repeated across two presentations and two follow-up states, not a broad quality or performance study.
Both arms pass core source/citation tasks; they are not two fully passing arms under the strict no-internal-IDs rubric.
Successful bookmark reuse here does not itself test live revocation, replacement, deletion, token expiry or arbitrary later sessions; those protections have local regression coverage.

Navigation retains declared protected application bookmark metadata while compact retains its full selector. No prior tool/source payload is restored; declared prior assistant prose is retained and is not treated as fresh source evidence. This is not a prose-only matched-state comparison.
No causal efficiency conclusion or broader model reliability follows from this single sample; measured usage is reported separately.

relativeInputObservations.interpretation: All completed stages counted; navigation passes strict rubric, compact B fails internal-ID display. These are observed usage differences, not two fully passing arms or general causal efficiency proof.
